title: Build status
description: status.json: how the latest attempt went, written whether or not anything was published. Advisory: the manifest and its hashes decide what is good. Fixed text and counts only. Consumers ignore unknown fields.

state.description: blocked: a gate held the numbers back. failed: the build stopped on an internal error. In both, the manifest's numbers are the last good ones.

generated_at.description: Optional: when this attempt ran, by the caller's clock. status-sources-v1.

reason.description: The one plain line to show when not published.

last_good.description: What the manifest holds. Null when nothing good has been published, or the published files fail their hashes.

gate_detail.description: Which account and month each statement gate is about, including accepted_gaps: statement gaps the owner accepted, which warn instead of block. Masks, dates and counts only.

invariants.description: Optional, written during the build: status-invariants-v1. Counts, basis points and masks only. Advisory: nothing is held back on it.

sources.description: Optional: status-sources-v1. How old each source is, and which numbers lean on it.

generated_at.description: When that build ran. Null until the box passes --generated-at.
